title.en: Quality styling and swift nail trims

text.en: Dog owners report high satisfaction with the grooming results and nail clipping provided at the salon. Reviewers commend the team for managing overgrown claws efficiently and delivering neat, professional breed styling. Clients appreciate that walk-in nail trims are completed quickly, leaving dogs looking tidy and feeling comfortable.

Clients praise salon owner Ruth and her staff for their welcoming attitude, expertise, and helpful advice. Reviewers note that the team creates a supportive environment for both pet owners and academy students learning professional grooming standards. Visitors describe the groomers as approachable, communicative, and accommodating.

Pet parents highlight the gentle handling shown towards dogs that feel anxious during grooming appointments. Reviewers share that staff take time to keep animals relaxed during stressful tasks like claw clipping, ensuring a positive experience. Owners feel reassured knowing their companions are treated with genuine patience and care.

q.en: Are walk-in nail clipping appointments accepted?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report that dogs can have their nails trimmed quickly as walk-ins without needing an advance booking.

q.en: Does the salon offer certified grooming training courses?

a.en: The academy provides City & Guilds qualification programmes and practical training for aspiring professional dog groomers.

q.en: Can puppies receive introductory grooming sessions?

a.en: Yes, the salon offers gentle puppy introduction packages designed to help young dogs acclimatize to salon sounds and handling.
